We do not accept personal checks. | MY INSURANCE ADJUSTER HAS NOT SEEN MY CAR YET. DO I HAVE TO FINISH THAT PROCESS BEFORE I GIVE YOU THE KEYS TO MY CAR? | Absolutely not. If it’s easier for you to leave your car with us and have the adjuster do their appraisal here, that’s no problem. However, please be mindful of your rental car benefits on your insurance. Consult your insurance company regarding your rental car benefits. Disney Paint and Body works closely with all the major insurance companies and can easily advise them of any work and repairs that need to be done to your vehicle. | I WAS JUST INVOLVED IN AN ACCIDENT. I’VE ALREADY CONTACTED ALL THE NECESSARY AUTHORITIES, BUT WHAT SHOULD I DO NEXT? | First of all, we’re sorry you’re in this position. We are here to guide your through the repair process. If your vehicle is not drivable, please do not drive it due to safety concerns. Call us and we will arrange towing if needed. If your vehicle is drivable, and you feel safe in doing so, bring it in to meet with one of our advisors for an estimate. | DOES DISNEY PAINT AND BODY OFFER PAYMENT PLANS? | Unfortunately, no. Before we return your vehicle in pre-accident condition, we require full payment of the insurance deductible or the complete bill if paying out-of-pocket. | DO I HAVE TO GET MORE THAN ONE ESTIMATE? | You do not have to have more than one estimate to complete insurance company requirements and begin work on your vehicle. | I AM HAVING ISSUES SUBMITTING MY PHOTOS ONLINE. WHAT CAN I DO? | Sorry for any hiccups in our system. While we work to fix it, feel free to email your name, cell phone or home number and the photos you’d like to upload to Disney Paint and Body’s online estimators at | estimates@DisneyPaintandBody.com | . | DO I NEED TO SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT BEFORE VISITING THE DISNEY PAINT AND BODY LOCATION? | It’s best to first schedule an appointment to receive an estimate or drop off your vehicle for repair so that we can provide you with personal service. However, appointments are never necessary. Click | here | to contact us to schedule an appointment or give us a call at 904-610-7308. | HOW DO I KNOW DISNEY PAINT AND BODY IS BETTER THAN OTHER CAR REPAIR SHOPS? | To put your mind at ease, we always keep an open line of communication. Plus, rest assured, we won’t stop until we make it right. Your complete satisfaction is important to us. That’s why we allow customers to leave their unedited reviews right on our site. We have also reviews on google, yelp and FB. We welcome you to read those and compare them to our similar businesses in our area. Our customers are our best advertisement. | IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG WITH MY REPAIRS, WHO DO I CONTACT? | Quality materials and expert workmanship allow us to offer a lifetime warranty on all of our repairs. Simply contact us at Disney Paint and Body 904-610-7308 to schedule an appointment to come by and take care of any issue you may have with your vehicle repair. | WHAT IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG WITH ONE OF THE REPAIRS I HAD DONE AT DISNEY PAINT AND BODY A FEW YEARS FROM NOW? | While we’re confident this will not happen, we’re also available to help if it does. We back up all repair work with a lifetime warranty. That means whether it’s a month, a year or five years down the road, we’ll correct the problem. | OKAY, SO I’M READY TO BRING IN MY VEHICLE. WHAT CAN I EXPECT WHEN I GET THERE? | You will be greeted with a smile and a friendly hello when you come into our office. Our office staff will then complete a work order with the repair plan to be completed. You may hear some reminders to remove all personal items from your car including but not limited to weapons, baby seats, house keys and garage door openers. If you haven’t yet scheduled an appointment, you can do so by calling Disney Paint and Body at 904-610-7308 or clicking | here | . | WHAT ABOUT A RENTAL CAR? DON’T TELL ME I HAVE TO GO TO THEIR SITE TOO. | Only if you prefer to do so. We can often drop you off at the nearest rental car location free of charge. Ask about arranging this when you schedule your drop-off appointment. The average time for a vehicle to be in a repair shop is two weeks, so ask your insurance agent about your car rental coverage. Of course, we’ll do our best to get you back in your own vehicle as quickly as possible. | I HAVE APPLIED FOR A POSITION WITH DISNEY PAINT AND BODY. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? | Our recruiting team will carefully review your employment application, resume, and related information to match your qualifications with existing Disney Paint and Body career opportunities. If a career match is found, you will be contacted by a member of our team for an initial interview. | WHO ARE YOUR INSURANCE PARTNERS? | Customers have the right to choose any repair shop they choose. We do not accept personal checks. | MY INSURANCE ADJUSTER HAS NOT SEEN MY CAR YET. DO I HAVE TO FINISH THAT PROCESS BEFORE I GIVE YOU THE KEYS TO MY CAR? | Absolutely not. If it’s easier for you to leave your car with us and have the adjuster do their appraisal here, that’s no problem. However, please be mindful of your rental car benefits on your insurance. Consult your insurance company regarding your rental car benefits. Disney Paint and Body works closely with all the major insurance companies and can easily advise them of any work and repairs that need to be done to your vehicle. | I WAS JUST INVOLVED IN AN ACCIDENT. I’VE ALREADY CONTACTED ALL THE NECESSARY AUTHORITIES, BUT WHAT SHOULD I DO NEXT? | First of all, we’re sorry you’re in this position. We are here to guide your through the repair process. If your vehicle is not drivable, please do not drive it due to safety concerns. Call us and we will arrange towing if needed. If your vehicle is drivable, and you feel safe in doing so, bring it in to meet with one of our advisors for an estimate. | DOES DISNEY PAINT AND BODY OFFER PAYMENT PLANS? | Unfortunately, no. Before we return your vehicle in pre-accident condition, we require full payment of the insurance deductible or the complete bill if paying out-of-pocket. | DO I HAVE TO GET MORE THAN ONE ESTIMATE? | You do not have to have more than one estimate to complete insurance company requirements and begin work on your vehicle. | I AM HAVING ISSUES SUBMITTING MY PHOTOS ONLINE. WHAT CAN I DO? | Sorry for any hiccups in our system. While we work to fix it, feel free to email your name, cell phone or home number and the photos you’d like to upload to Disney Paint and Body’s online estimators at | estimates@DisneyPaintandBody.com | . | DO I NEED TO SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT BEFORE VISITING THE DISNEY PAINT AND BODY LOCATION? | It’s best to first schedule an appointment to receive an estimate or drop off your vehicle for repair so that we can provide you with personal service. However, appointments are never necessary. Click | here | to contact us to schedule an appointment or give us a call at 904-610-7308. | HOW DO I KNOW DISNEY PAINT AND BODY IS BETTER THAN OTHER CAR REPAIR SHOPS? | To put your mind at ease, we always keep an open line of communication. Plus, rest assured, we won’t stop until we make it right. Your complete satisfaction is important to us. That’s why we allow customers to leave their unedited reviews right on our site. We have also reviews on google, yelp and FB. We welcome you to read those and compare them to our similar businesses in our area. Our customers are our best advertisement. | IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG WITH MY REPAIRS, WHO DO I CONTACT? | Quality materials and expert workmanship allow us to offer a lifetime warranty on all of our repairs. Simply contact us at Disney Paint and Body 904-610-7308 to schedule an appointment to come by and take care of any issue you may have with your vehicle repair. | WHAT IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG WITH ONE OF THE REPAIRS I HAD DONE AT DISNEY PAINT AND BODY A FEW YEARS FROM NOW? | While we’re confident this will not happen, we’re also available to help if it does. We back up all repair work with a lifetime warranty. That means whether it’s a month, a year or five years down the road, we’ll correct the problem. | OKAY, SO I’M READY TO BRING IN MY VEHICLE. WHAT CAN I EXPECT WHEN I GET THERE? | You will be greeted with a smile and a friendly hello when you come into our office. Our office staff will then complete a work order with the repair plan to be completed. You may hear some reminders to remove all personal items from your car including but not limited to weapons, baby seats, house keys and garage door openers. If you haven’t yet scheduled an appointment, you can do so by calling Disney Paint and Body at 904-610-7308 or clicking | here | . | WHAT ABOUT A RENTAL CAR? DON’T TELL ME I HAVE TO GO TO THEIR SITE TOO. | Only if you prefer to do so. We can often drop you off at the nearest rental car location free of charge. Ask about arranging this when you schedule your drop-off appointment. The average time for a vehicle to be in a repair shop is two weeks, so ask your insurance agent about your car rental coverage. Of course, we’ll do our best to get you back in your own vehicle as quickly as possible. | I HAVE APPLIED FOR A POSITION WITH DISNEY PAINT AND BODY. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? | Our recruiting team will carefully review your employment application, resume, and related information to match your qualifications with existing Disney Paint and Body career opportunities. If a career match is found, you will be contacted by a member of our team for an initial interview. | WHO ARE YOUR INSURANCE PARTNERS? | Customers have the right to choose any repair shop they choose.
